headline: SwiftUI AI workout coach offers one-tap logging & GPT-4o analysis
summary: Body Forge, a new native iOS app, provides a clean, one-tap workout tracking experience during sets and delivers personalized post-workout analysis powered by GPT-4o, adapting programs as you progress.
details: Traditional workout trackers often lack context, burying users in data without guiding their next steps. Body Forge was designed as a pocket coach, offering clean tracking during sets and intelligent analysis afterward, with programs that adapt to progress.

The app's workout screen is optimized for single-hand use, displaying only essential information like current sets, reps, and weight. All other details, like graphs or historical data, are deferred until the session concludes, avoiding distractions during a set.

After a workout, Body Forge sends a concise summary of volume, intensity, and progression over the last three weeks to GPT-4o. The AI then generates a short, personalized analysis, suggesting concrete adjustments for future sessions, such as deloading if progress has stalled.

The key to efficient AI analysis lies in the structured data sent to GPT-4o. Instead of raw logs, the app first builds a simplified summary, allowing the model to reason effectively and return a personalized response in approximately 10 seconds.

Body Forge is now available on the App Store. To explain its unique value beyond a simple listing, the app also features a dedicated bilingual website, bodyforges.com, designed to direct users to the App Store with a fast-loading, dark-themed interface.

headline_marked: [[Immigration law firm uses RAG AI]] to automate FAQs, generate leads
headline: Immigration law firm uses RAG AI to automate FAQs, generate leads
summary: A Warsaw immigration law firm implemented a RAG AI consultant powered by GPT-4o and a knowledge base of over 200 real cases, streamlining client inquiries and lead generation.
details: An immigration lawyer in Warsaw faced daily repetitive questions and a website that failed to generate leads. Clients often asked about required documents and processing times for "karta pobytu," leading to manual responses for every initial inquiry.

To address this, the firm rebuilt its website, integrating an AI consultant. This assistant is designed to answer common questions directly from the firm's own extensive material, improving efficiency and client engagement.

The AI assistant runs on GPT-4o with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Its knowledge base comprises over 200 real cases handled by the firm and official documents, with chunks stored as embeddings in Postgres using pgvector.

Crucially, the assistant does not replace legal consultations. After answering standard queries, it collects contact details and a case summary, then sends a concise request via Telegram directly to the lawyer, pre-qualifying leads.

An unexpected benefit emerged: ChatGPT now frequently names the firm's site when users inquire about immigration help in Warsaw. This improved visibility is attributed to clear service pages and structured data, alongside the AI integration.
